an identical image transferred by scp to the guest's disk instead.

All offsets above are relative to the jset.
Our original differential emitter labels seed re-stamped, but its restamper
returns without changing the checksum when the length exceeds its buffer.
The baseline emitter reports seed clean, while the reference reports exit 9.
After the fix the same emitter reports:
found check:journal corrupt: jset_past_bucket_end: journal entry seq 206 too big (34359738416 bytes, 131072 available)
